caption: One continuous night-market noodle stall multishot scene. The same central subject, setting, material identity, lighting family, and event continuity should carry across all camera cuts. Source caption evidence: A chef with a shaved head, a black dragon tattoo covering his right forearm, a small silver hoop earring in his left ear, and a red bandana tied around his neck cooks noodles in a steel wok at a steamy night-market stall lit by hanging red lanterns, wearing a white T-shirt under a navy apron.
contrast_caption: A different unrelated subject, object set, location, lighting condition, or event replaces the scene between shots.
invariant_caption: The same chef persists across every shot: shaved head, black dragon tattoo on the right forearm, small silver hoop earring in the left ear, red bandana around the neck, white T-shirt under a navy apron. The same night-market noodle stall persists, with its steel wok station, rising steam, hanging red lanterns, and stainless counter, despite legitimate camera, framing, and action changes.
